Vehicle Maintenance Tracker (VMT) is a simple yet powerful tool designed to help you keep a complete history of your vehicles’ maintenance. Whether you're tracking a single car or managing a fleet, VMT makes it easy to stay organized and informed.

Key Features:
*Add and update vehicle details, including photo, VIN, license plate, year, make, model, tire size, oil filter type, current odometer, and annual maintenance costs.
*Set, view, and reset due dates for upcoming services.
*Archive vehicles you no longer own and restore or permanently delete them at any time.
*Manage maintenance records for multiple vehicles—oil changes, brakes, tires, batteries, and more.
*Attach photos of maintenance receipts for better documentation.
*Search and filter maintenance records easily.
*Maintenance entries are organized and sorted chronologically for quick reference.
*Export or email vehicle data in CSV format for printing or sharing.

I hope you enjoy using VMT as much as I enjoyed building it. If you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions, feel free to reach out—and don't forget to join the **VMT community on Facebook**! It's the best way to connect with me and other users, get updates, and suggest new features.

Happy Tracking!

Can you relate with the following?
- You don’t know when your next oil change is due?
- You want to be prepared when taking your vehicle for servicing?
- You do your own maintenance and want to keep detailed records
- You love your car very much and want to extend it's lifespan and safety

If you nodded yes, this app is for you! Keep comprehensive maintenance records, set reminders, and stay on top of your vehicle's health—right from your iOS devices.

- Service Reminders - 
Never miss a maintenance milestone. Preloaded reminders cover all the essentials, grouped by category for easy organization. Here's a glimpse:
- Fluids: oil change, transmission fluid, brake fluid 
- Filters: cabin and air filter replacement
- Tires: tire rotations, wheel alignment
- Battery: annual checkup of your battery, battery replacement
- Engine: spark plugs, timing belt
- Brakes: Service brakes, replace brake pads

Fully customize reminders based on your vehicle’s recommended intervals, or add your own to reflect specific needs.

- Widget: At-a-Glance Overview - 
Stay informed with a Home Screen widget that highlights your car's health at a glance. Each category is color-coded, letting you see which maintenance tasks are coming up soon.

- Notifications: You’ll never miss an oil change again! - 
Get timely reminders to update your vehicle’s mileage (weekly or monthly) and perform essential maintenance, with alerts 1 month, 1 week, or right when it’s due.

- 100% Privacy for Your Data -
Your data stays on your device and is securely stored in your iCloud—no third-party access, ever. Sync across all your devices seamlessly.

- Add Attachments - 
Document every detail by attaching photos to your maintenance records. Upload receipts from dealerships and/or include photos of parts or components replaced. Attachments are securely stored in your iCloud Drive, accessible on all your devices.

- Export with ease - 
Export your maintenance records in PDF or CSV format. Perfect for sharing or personal backups.

Keep your car running smoothly, extend its lifespan, and stay safe on the road. Start tracking your vehicle’s maintenance today!

MNTR is a simple car service log and maintenance tracker.
Track services, oil changes and parts, monitor mileage
and get reminders for upcoming maintenance.

MNTR helps to keep car maintenance under full control. 
This is an application for tracking and accounting the service intervals of cars, motorcycles and any other types of equipment. 
It provides simple and effective tools to ensure that all maintenance of your car is carried out on time. 
Oil, spark plugs, or any other consumables must be replaced strictly on time. If replaced later, the oil, for example, will lose its properties and the engine may undergo increased wear. If you replace it ahead of time, it is financially inefficient, since the product being replaced still has a working resource that costs money. 

Opportunities:
- Adding vehicles for tracking
- Adding tracking parameters from preset (oil, filters, candles, belts, etc.) and custom ones
- Quick mileage update button on the home screen
- Data synchronization with iCloud - Data will not be lost when you replace your phone and is available on all devices with your iCloud account.
- Convenient graphical indication of the parameter status on the main screen
- View the service history with the ability to filter the necessary parameters
- Export the service history as a PDF file
- The ability to leave comments on each parameter

Add maintenance records:
- oil change
- filters
- brakes
- any other consumables. Choose from pre-installed ones or create your own

MNTR is a modern electronic service book
that is always at hand.
